A Paladin is a holy knight, fighting for the cause of good in all aspects of life.
She shares some Clerical powers and fights nearly as well as a Warrior, and possesses the innate ability to Lay Hands. - EverQuest manual =Description= [[File:C paladin.gif|right]] Paladins are holy warriors who call upon the gods to channel divine spells and strength of arms in the fight against evil and the undead. They are a primarily defensive melee class, able to wear plate armor, wield many kinds of weapons, and access divine magic. Paladins are able fighters and battlefield healers. They supplement their melee combat fortitude with the ability to stun and smite foes as well as increase the health and armor of allies. Each day, paladins are gifted by the gods, with the ability to Lay Hands on one person. Lay Hands is a powerful heal, prized for its potential to recover a seemingly doomed battle. Powerful paladins are a great force against evil and eventually gain special abilities to smite undead foes and even resurrect slain allies. Errant paladins may brave the dangers of Norrath alone, provided they have sufficient equipment and knowledge. Used to its full potential the paladin's toolkit is substantial, however it is most potent as the bedrock foundation of an adventuring party. Players who like to engage in melee combat but want the option to cast modest heals and buffs may find paladins a great class to play. === Class Titles === In the original [[Kunark]] expansion, classes would gain new titles at levels over 50. In EverQuest Legends, these titles are not available, and it is unknown how they will be presented. While they may be available with future level cap increases, they are included here only for posterity: {| class="eoTable2" ! Level 1-50 ! Level 51-54 ! Level 55-59 ! As a paladin, you are expected to have a high amount of hit points and AC to perform your main role as a tank and a decent mana pool to cast your aggro spells (flash of light and stun). * '''Wisdom''': Will increase your mana pool. * '''Strength''': Will increase your damage output (albeit slightly). * '''Dexterity''': Will increase the likelihood of procs (Ghoulbane, Fiery Avenger, and Fiery Defender come to mind). * '''Charisma''': Will decrease the critical resist rate of the [[Lull]] line of spells. == Religion == Paladins must choose a religion, as their magic powers flow from their devotion to their chosen god. There is only one significant item for paladins that your deity will affect, and that is the [[Natures Defender]] (Tunare only). Your religion will also impact where your human or half-elf character can start. Selections include [[Karana]], [[Rodcet Nife]], [[Erollisi Marr]], [[Brell Serilis]], [[Mithaniel Marr]], [[Prexus]], [[Tunare]], and [[Quellious]]. Depending on your race you will be given a different number of these deities to choose from. You may also want to view [[Deity Specific Items]].
